summary: Produced a compilable standalone TikZ figure (version 2, best version). It draws a full circle centred at O with diameter AB, chords DB, CB and DC, and labels A, B, C, D, O. The Critic scored it 0.93 with no open issues and must_repair=false. The unlabeled crossing X of DC with AB is drawn implicitly, without a printed letter, as the source shows.
